concept.name: Everyday Noodles
concept.tagline: Hand-pulled noodles and Chinese favorites in Squirrel Hill,

menu.name: Braised Beef Noodle Soup (S)
menu.description: Noodle soup with braised beef, served in a choice of thin or wide flour noodles or rice noodles.
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout container of braised beef noodle soup with tender beef chunks, noodles, and green onion in a clear broth, sealed with a plastic lid and paper bag, no text, no people.

menu.name: Braised Beef Tendon Noodle Soup (S)
menu.description: Noodle soup with braised beef tendon, served in a choice of thin or wide flour noodles or rice noodles.
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout container of braised beef tendon noodle soup with gelatinous tendon pieces, noodles, and greens in a dark broth, sealed with a plastic lid and paper bag, no text, no people.

menu.name: Oxtail Noodle Soup Consomme
menu.description: Noodle soup with oxtail in a clear consomme broth.
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout container of oxtail noodle soup in a clear golden consomme with noodles and oxtail pieces, sealed with a plastic lid and paper bag, no text, no people.

menu.name: Dan Dan Noodles Szechuan Style
menu.description: Szechuan-style noodles with peanut sauce, served with a choice of thin or wide flour noodles or rice noodles.
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout container of Szechuan dan dan noodles tossed in peanut sauce with minced pork and chili oil, topped with green onion, sealed with a plastic lid and paper bag, no text, no people.

menu.name: Hot Spicy Wonton Noodles
menu.description: Noodles with shrimp pork wontons in a hot and spicy sauce.
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout container of hot spicy wonton noodles with plump wontons in red chili sauce and scallions, sealed with a plastic lid and paper bag, no text, no people.

menu.name: Pork Soup Dumplings (8)
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout box holding eight steamed pork soup dumplings with pleated tops in a paper liner, no text, no people.

menu.name: Sweet Egg Yolk Steamed Buns (3)
menu.description: Three steamed buns filled with sweet egg yolk.
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout box with three soft golden steamed buns with sweet egg yolk filling visible on a paper liner, no text, no people.

brand.logoPrompt: A flat two-color mark of a single noodle strand curling into a simple bowl shape, with the name Everyday Noodles set in a clean sans-serif beside it.
brand.voice: Friendly and direct, inviting neighbors to watch the noodles being pulled and order a freshly made bowl.
